purpose: Controller inspection questions fixed before a new checker result; not ground-truth labels and not provided as checker input.

cases.inspect: Does comparison distinguish broad rare-event/WKB methods from the specific joint eco-evolutionary path/resilience question? Does absence from an abstract stay UNKNOWN rather than DISTINCT?

Do immunology game-theory/resource-allocation neighbours actually cover the proposed local-rule aggregation, or only its context? Does a new mechanism-design label get treated as a substantive claim without evidence?
Does existing strategy-environment feedback cover the full proposed incentive-compatibility/implementability question, or only a core feedback component?
Which original claims are covered by multidimensional stability versus sampling/null-model papers? Is any claim about predictive-state sufficiency actually supported by a cited passage?

Does bulk transcriptomic deconvolution cover the functional-endpoint prediction and separation of within-cell response, composition, survival and interaction explanations? Keep partial overlap distinct from complete coverage.
